title: 33-year-old man found dead in actress Krishi Thapanda's apartment, probe underway
summary: A 33-year-old man, Vaishak, was discovered deceased under suspicious circumstances at Kannada actress Krishi Thapanda's Bengaluru apartment. Police confirmed Vaishak knew the actress and had visited her residence on Wednesday night.
